app.title: Show HN: StemJSON – a language for LLMs to extend native mobile apps on the fly
app.author: vkrychun
app.description: A lightweight domain‑specific language that lets LLMs generate and modify native mobile UI components at runtime, integrating with iOS and Android frameworks.
proposed_tests: initialize a basic iOS project and run stemjson CLI to generate a View
build the Android project with Gradle and verify the generated code compiles
measure latency of a sample LLM prompt that outputs a UI layout
compare output with a hand‑coded equivalent for correctness
